title: Chapter 336 The Fate Of The Traitor
content:
Chapter 336 The Fate Of The Traitor

In the evil god camp, in addition to the foreign race believers and native race believers of the evil god, there is also a group of very special people.

This group of people are from all races in the native camp. They voluntarily live in the sphere of influence of the evil god camp, and the evil gods in the evil god camp do not force them to believe.

They betrayed this world and their respective races, joined the evil god camp, enjoyed the protection and various generous benefits of the evil god camp, and lived a carefree life. They can be said to be the most relaxed group of people in the world.

This group of people are all pure native races that the evil god camp has lured in various ways. The evil god camp will not use means to control them, but will only brainwash them through various information to make them wholeheartedly throw themselves into the arms of the evil god camp.

The evil god camp will even use them as an example to attract more people from the native camp to join.

In the eyes of the world rule will and the great universe will, this group of people are still pure creatures of this world, not polluted by external forces.

For so many years, the evil god camp has been developing this group, and it has been passed down from generation to generation. Most of these people don’t even know what the outside world looks like.

However, there is no free lunch in this world. The evil god camp went to great lengths to create such a large group of traitors, and of course there was a purpose.

…

The Zerg and Protoss, who have completed the integration of their internal forces, began to put all their forces into the battlefield of the camp war.

Wu Qing is no longer prepared to abide by the unspoken rules of the two camps. The powerful Protoss army directly attacks the evil god camp army.

The Protoss has manifested a large number of Protoss high-level templars suitable for large-scale battlefield operations. The ion storm attack of the Protoss high-level templars is the nemesis of all armies.

As long as there is a battle of a certain scale, there will be the figure of the Protoss high-level templars. The terrible lightning attack produced by the ion storm has become the nightmare of the evil god camp army.

The strong men of the evil god camp also frequently took action, but they could not escape the poisonous hands of the Zerg and Protoss strong men.

The various arms of the Zerg and Protoss have the ability to kill the enemy above their level, and many arms also have the skills of one-hit kill.

As long as the strong men of the evil god camp dare to show up, there is no way to retreat unscathed.

Whether it was ordinary troops or star-level warriors, the evil god camp was suppressed by the Zerg and Protoss.

With the strong leadership of the Zerg and Protoss, the armies of all races in the entire local camp no longer conserved their strength, but launched a full-scale counterattack against the evil god camp and quickly captured the territory of the evil god camp.

In addition to the main battle line of the camp war, the local camps in other areas, under the leadership of the Zerg and Protoss armies, launched a strong counterattack, and beat the evil god camp army without a single chance of fighting back.

If this situation continues, it won't take long for the evil god camp to be defeated by the local camp led by the Zerg and Protoss.

With the strong intervention of the Zerg and Protoss, the evil god camp, which originally had the advantage, has already failed.

This is an unacceptable outcome for all foreign evil gods. Those foreign evil gods are powerful and have many means, but they are restricted by the will of the universe. Some means cannot be used, and some means require some price to be paid before they can be used.

Foreign evil gods will not be frightened by the sudden rise of the Zerg and Protoss.

Now the power of the foreign evil gods in this world is no longer enough to resist the counterattack of the local camp. The power of this world has become stronger and stronger due to a series of actions by the Zerg and the Protoss.

The continuous recovery of this world is damaging the interests of the foreign evil gods.

This situation must not continue.

Those groups that betrayed this world and their respective races will finally play their due role at this time.

Sacrifice!

This is their predetermined fate!

The various forces in the evil god camp have been raising a large number of traitors in the local camp, and they have not forced them to believe in the evil gods, in order to sacrifice them when needed.

The foreign evil gods use a large number of intelligent lives with the imprint of the local world for sacrifice, which can effectively cross some of the restrictions of the will of the universe and project a large amount of power into this world.

This is like the disputes between countries in the ordinary world. Some countries will cultivate traitors in other countries. When necessary, they will let these traitors disguise themselves as ordinary people, guide public opinion, and call for external intervention to create opportunities for external forces.

"Your own people ask us to intervene, we must come forward!"

Such an excuse is perfect.

The foreign evil gods sacrificed a large number of intelligent lives with the imprint of the local world, just like calling on the outside world to intervene in the affairs of the local world. The will of the universe generally turned a blind eye to such things.

If it is the believers of the evil god who sacrifice, no matter how many sacrifices are made, it is useless. The local world does not recognize the identity of the evil god believers as local lives, and the will of the universe will not recognize it either.

…

After enjoying countless years of peaceful and prosperous life, a large number of local camp traitors living in various parts of the evil god camp finally have to pay the price they deserve.

Countless sacrificial platforms were built in the areas where a large number of local camp traitors lived. The traitors of various races who had no sense of crisis and had very low combat power suddenly ushered in a catastrophe.

The armies of the various forces of the evil god camp rushed in, caught everyone like chickens, and sent them to the sacrificial platform.

Amid countless cries and pleas for mercy, a bloody massacre without mercy began.

Every sacrificial platform became a sea of blood and corpses!

Regardless of gender, age or young, the evil god camp killed all the traitors of the local camp without leaving a single one alive!

Faced with such death and slaughter, there are still many people who are confused by the evil god camp's fallacies and heresies, thinking that this is the revenge of the local camp and do not believe that the evil god camp will raise the butcher knife against them.

Wu Qing also discovered such a large-scale sacrifice, but he did not stop it.

Wu Qing's ultimate goal is to let the system exploit the loopholes of the will of the universe. Now those foreign evil gods have made such a large-scale sacrifice, which just gives the system an opportunity.

As for the various forces that the foreign evil gods have invested in this world through large-scale sacrifices, the Zerg and the Protoss will eventually have to face them. It is very beneficial for the Zerg and the Protoss to be able to confront each other in this world.

In order to save itself, this world will definitely support the Zerg and Protoss at all costs. This is another opportunity for the system.

The sphere of influence of the evil god camp in this world is full of large-scale sacrifices. Half of the sky of the world seems to be dyed red by the blood of the sacrifices.

The simultaneous disappearance of countless intelligent life in the native world finally triggered a certain rule, and the celestial phenomena of the whole world began to undergo terrible changes.
